Get your gaming fix without current-gen bandwidth requirements. Check out RetroArch.

Current-gen gaming can be a pain for the bandwidth challenged. Even when you buy a game on disc, you're sometimes required to download large updates in order to play the game in its entirety. Although not as graphically impressive as current gen gaming, retro gaming can be an entertaining way to play games with much lighter bandwidth requirements.

RetroArch is a front-end for a library of emulator cores know collectively as Libretro. With RetroArch installed on a PC or other supported device, you can emulate old video game consoles and play games in the form of ROMs available on the internet.

RetroArch is available for a variety of devices and is available here: http://www.libretro.com/

If you're looking to convert a Raspberry PI, mini-PC, or other supported device into a dedicated RetroArch machine, check out the Libretro partner project, Lakka: http://www.lakka.tv/
